Russian Hot Tea
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 3:54pm

Ingredients




1 (8 oz.) jar Tang breakfast orange drink
1 pkg. lemonade mix (pkg. size to make 1-quart)
2 cups sugar
1/2 cup instant tea, unsweetened
1 teaspoon cinnamon
1 teaspoon ground cloves

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients together thoroughly and store in moisture-proof container. To each cup of boiling water use 1-2 teaspoons of the mix, according to taste.
